mainEntity.name: How does generative design differ from traditional architectural methods?

acceptedAnswer.text: Traditional design relies on manual iteration by architects, while generative AI rapidly tests thousands of variations simultaneously, often discovering optimized or unconventional layouts that humans might overlook. digitalbluefoam+1
